text:
maya shah: noticed weird telemetry in console - some dashboards showing wrong tenant counts after rapid org-switching. saw rows from other orgs in a couple of sessions :confused:

samir patel: yikes. any repro steps? is this on canary or main?

maya shah: repro on canary rollout of route-affinity change (branch: feature/affinity-prefetch). quick switch between org A -> org B -> org A. sometimes the sidepanel shows org B cards while header shows A. happened twice in 15 runs.

josh liu: putting a hypothesis: prefetch cache + cookie/affinity header not cleared on quick nav. route middleware sets X-Org but prefetch worker reuses old session for async fetches.

priya rao: adding logs from my repro run: 
```
[2025-08-02T15:12:03Z] prefetch.request id=ff7a org=A ctx=tx123
[2025-08-02T15:12:03Z] quick-switch to org=B user=maya session=sess-9
[2025-08-02T15:12:03Z] prefetch.worker reused sess-9 org=A -> returned cards(org=A)
[2025-08-02T15:12:03Z] ui rendered with cards(org=A) header(org=B)
```

samir patel: that matches. prefetch is enqueuing jobs with session-scoped headers. when session cookie is rotated we don't attach the new org header to pending jobs.

maya shah: this also looks bad in telemetry: dashboard counts jump as if two orgs' metrics merged. can we add a short-term guard?

josh liu: minimal patch idea: on route change, add a small TTL'd invalidation token on session and require prefetch jobs to re-check token before using cached headers. cheap and low-risk.

priya rao: or simpler: clear tenant header on any prefetch job start and reconstruct from the latest auth token. pseudo: 
```
// express middleware for prefetch worker
req.headers['x-org'] = undefined
const auth = await sessionService.resolve(req.cookies.session)
if (auth) req.headers['x-org'] = auth.org
next()
```

samir patel: prefer priya's approach. explicit clear+re-resolve avoids token races. josh's token approach works but needs extra token plumbing for existing queue workers.

maya shah: agree. priya, can you sketch a tiny test to catch this in CI? want to block merge without regression.

priya rao: yep — will add an integration test that simulates switch, enqueues prefetch, asserts prefetch uses latest org header. also add a telemetry tag `prefetch_org_mismatch:true` when mismatch happens so we can alert.

josh liu: matching telemetry is good. also flag quota attribution: if prefetch attributes tokens to wrong org we may bill incorrectly. add a check to billing pipeline to reconcile attribution for recent commits.

samir patel: I'll open the PR with the middleware change + test. will mark as hotfix and target canary only first. add risk label and rollout instructions.

maya shah: nice. once PR up ping #release-war-room — we may want a quick revert plan if we see perf regression.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch feature/affinity-prefetch (canary) to cluster-canary-4 at 2025-08-02T15:18:00Z :white_check_mark:

priya rao: added telemetry tag to local repro; saw two events with prefetched_org!=header_org. saving logs and adding to incident tracker.

maya shah: thanks all — priority P2 but high impact for enterprise tenants. let's iterate on the PR today. :thumbsup:
